snippet.title: SOLAR gameplay: fly the real Solar System in your browser, by voice
snippet.description:
SOLAR is a free browser game where you fly a spaceship through the real Solar System, and you can fly it by talking to it: say "take off", "dock" or "land on the Moon" and the ship does it.

This is one pilot's run, cut together, with the long landings sped up: cargo from Earth to the ISS, the Moon, the James Webb and Hubble space telescopes, the Apollo landing site, and back to Earth. Planet positions come from JPL orbital elements, flights follow Newtonian physics, and a hold-to-boost time accelerator compresses days of flight into seconds.

Play free, no install, no sign-up: https://xtotam.com
Press kit: https://xtotam.com/press
Development streams: https://twitch.tv/xtotam
Built solo in Three.js / WebGL.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:04 On the launch pad: load cargo, "Take off" by voice
0:12 Time boost on the climb to orbit
0:36 Autodock with the ISS
1:07 To the Moon: "Land on the Moon" by voice
1:19 Lunar landing (4x speed)
2:09 James Webb Space Telescope: "Dock" by voice
2:40 New mission: a package for Earth
2:54 Touchdown on Earth, paid on the ground
3:11 Lift-off through the clouds
4:29 Back at the ISS
5:14 Apollo landing site
5:31 James Webb again
6:04 The Apollo lander
6:46 Survey mission to the ISS
7:58 Cargo for Hubble
8:12 Autodock with Hubble
8:53 Play SOLAR
